selection: Regions fixed after development scans; primary masses chosen to retain the previous 200/420 kg comparison. Every fresh validation road and every mode retained, including failures. Region-specific interpretation only.
success: Positive group mean NN adaptive and oracle gains for both primary directions, at least 20 of 24 roads improving, no force violation or tire contact loss. Report absolute RMS and neighboring mass results.
representative: Upper median fixed-controller loaded RMS, without looking at adaptive gain. Figures use all-road aggregate curves rather than selecting individual improvements.
